description: Financial news in two modes. 'company': recent articles for one symbol over a date range — headline, source, datetime, summary, URL ("what's driving AAPL today?"); requires `symbol`. 'market': broad market headlines by category (general, forex, crypto, merger); uses `category`. Resolve a company name with finnhub_search_symbols first for company mode.

category.description: Market mode: news category. See finnhub://news-categories.

from.description: Company mode: window start (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today − 7 days.

limit.description: Max articles (1–100). Default 15 — news lists run long; keep context lean.

mode.description: 'company' = recent articles for one symbol over a date range (requires `symbol`). 'market' = broad headlines by `category`.

symbol.description: Required for `company` mode. US ticker. Ignored in `market` mode.

to.description: Company mode: window end (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

name: finnhub_get_news

category.description: Finnhub category tag (market mode). Note: the response category may differ from the requested category (e.g., "business" for a "general" request).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `missing_symbol`: mode 'company' was requested without a symbol. `not_us_or_paid`: Upstream HTTP 403 on the symbol. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when no articles were found.

totalCount.description: Total articles available before the limit.

truncated.description: True when articles were capped at the limit.

title: Finnhub Get News
